fields.name: title

fields.description: What the video is, for anyone who cannot see it.

fields.name: fallback
fields.label: If the player cannot load
fields.description: Shown in place of the player when a browser or network blocks it. Usually the track name and a direct link.

fields.name: src

fields.label: Captions file
fields.description: A .vtt subtitle file. Without one this video is unusable for anyone deaf — please add it.

fields.name: poster
fields.label: Still image
fields.description: Shown before anyone presses play.

fields.name: href
fields.label: Link
fields.description: A page on this site like /help-us/, or a full address like https://example.org

fields.name: newTab
fields.label: Open in a new tab
fields.description: Leave off for pages on this site. Turn on for somewhere else entirely.

fields.name: layout
fields.label: Width
fields.description: Columns stack into one on a phone whichever you choose.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe this picture
fields.description: What would you say to someone on the phone who cannot see it? A person’s name, what is happening, what the graphic says.

fields.name: decorative
fields.label: This picture is decorative
fields.description: Tick only if the picture adds nothing a reader would miss. It will be hidden from screen readers. Leave unticked and write a description for every photograph of a person.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Form name
fields.description: Shown with each message so you know which form it came from.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Field name
fields.description: Lowercase, no spaces. This is the heading it arrives under.

fields.name: consent
fields.label: Consent line
fields.description: A tick box people must agree to before sending. Leave empty for none.

fields.name: success
fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.description: Shown in place of the form once it has sent.

fields.name: action
fields.label: Send submissions to
fields.description: Leave as netlify unless you have your own endpoint.

fields.name: html
fields.label: HTML
fields.description: An escape hatch. Anything here is published exactly as written.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Web address
fields.description: Leave empty and we will build one from the title. Fill it in only to move a page — changing it breaks every existing link and any search result pointing at it.
